jobs.description:
Penske Logistics is looking for warehouse dock associates to become part of an excellent team. This is a great opportunity for individuals who are safety conscious and have a pleasant, outgoing attitude who want to excel in a warehouse environment.

Why is Penske Logistics for you?

We take pride in offering a competitive wage and great benefits including:

$22.50/hr Base Rate

$1.00 Shift Differential

Work Schedule:

•Monday to Friday 3:30pm - Midnight

Additional Benefits:

• Paid Time Off

• Medical Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Life Insurance

• 401K

• Associate Referral Program

• $125 Boot allowance after 90-days of employment

Our associates also enjoy numerous associate discounts and opportunities to grow with the organization!

Job Responsibilities:

• Follow all safety requirements

• Stage and sort products for loading

• Loads and unloads trailers in a safe manner

• Opens and closes dock doors

• Maintain a clean and safe work area

• Sorts and places parts in racks or other designated areas

• Stacks cardboard boxes and pallets

• Move materials within the warehouse

• May operate electric pallet jacks and forklifts as needed

• Scan freights/parts

Qualifications:

• No prior warehouse experience required but preferred.

• High school diploma or equivalent preferred

• Proficient reading skills and ability to follow directions required

• Ability to work independently, customer service, dealing with others, multi-tasking skills, organizational skills, flexible, excellent with numbers and time management skills required

• Flexible to work overtime preferred

• Ability to work in non-climate-controlled conditions required

• Regular, predictable, full attendance is an essential function of the job

• Ability to work independently, customer service, multi-tasking skills, organizational skills, flexible, and time management skills required

• Willingness to work the required schedule, work at the specific location required

• Complete a Penske employment application, submit to a background investigation (to include past employment, education, and criminal history) and drug screening required.

This position is designated as safety sensitive by the company, and the ability to work in a constant state of alertness and in a safe manner is required. Associates must have the ability to accept responsibility for their own safety, as well as the safety of others.

Physical Requirements:

-The physical and mental demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

-The associate will be required to remember and understand certain instructions, guidelines, or other information. The associate must be able to see and verbally communicate. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

-While performing the duties of this job, the associate will be required to move frequently, stand, walk, and sit. The associate is frequently required to use hands to touch, handle, and feel, and to reach with hands and arms. The associate must be able to regularly lift and/or move up to 50lbs/23kg and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100lbs/45kg.

Penske is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Benefits: Our excellent benefits plan keeps associates and their families happy, healthy and secure. To learn more visit https://penske.jobs/benefits/

Penske Logistics engineers state-of-the-art transportation, warehousing and freight management solutions that deliver powerful business results for market-leading companies. With operations in North America, South America, Europe and Asia, Penske and its associates help businesses move forward by increasing visibility and driving down supply-chain costs. Visit Penske Logistics to learn more.

jobs.description:
Chicago Role Highlights

At a Glance

  • New Opening: Part-Time Warehouse With Benefits — Part-time Hours Full-time Benefits
  • Location: Chicago, IL
  • Company: UPS
  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in customer service.
  • Our UPS team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Package Logistics industry.

Rewards

  • Earnings: $21-$23/Hour (approx. $23.1k/Year)
  • Benefits: Flexible scheduling available.
  • Earn extra cash with a stable local employer.

Day-to-Day

  • Apply your your professional skills skills in a flexible Chicago environment.

About UPS & Our Culture

It sounds too good to be true — part-time hours with full-time quality benefits. But at UPS, it has been the reality for decades, and it is one of the primary reasons our part-time workforce has some of the highest retention rates in the logistics industry. Our Part-Time Warehouse positions with benefits are the rare exception in the American labor market — roles where Teamsters union medical, dental, and vision coverage, pension contributions, and paid personal time are available to associates working as few as 17.5 hours per week. When you search for warehouse jobs with benefits near me, nothing else on the market delivers what UPS does at the part-time level.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I took this job because my family needed health insurance and I could not afford individual coverage. UPS's Teamsters medical plan costs me a fraction of what individual insurance costs, covers my entire family, and is genuinely better coverage than what my spouse gets at their full-time job. I work 20 hours a week, I am home by 9:30 AM every morning, and my family's healthcare is completely handled. For anyone searching for warehouse jobs with benefits at part-time hours, UPS is completely in its own league." - Current Part-Time Associate with Benefits, Nashville, TN.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Part-Time Warehouse Associate with Benefits, you work a structured 3.5 to 5 hour sort shift inside our package center, performing the core loading, sorting, and unloading functions that keep the UPS delivery network running — and accessing a benefits package that most part-time employers do not even attempt to offer.

  • Core Sort Functions: Execute UPS's standard sort operation tasks — unloading trailers, sorting packages on conveyor systems, and loading delivery vehicles in sequence order — building skill and speed across all three functions over time on a consistent part-time schedule.
  • Benefits Enrollment Navigation: Work with UPS's onboarding team to enroll in Teamsters union medical, dental, and vision benefits, understand your pension accrual schedule, and register for the UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance program within your first weeks on the job.
  • Consistent Schedule Reliability: Maintain consistent attendance across your assigned part-time shift window — the foundation on which your Teamsters union seniority, annual wage progression, and long-term benefits eligibility are all built.

Benefits & Perks

This UPS part-time position includes the full Teamsters union benefits package — medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and eligible dependents, a defined-benefit pension plan, paid personal days, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance covering up to $25,000 in education costs. Weekly paychecks and contractual annual wage progression raises complete a benefits offering that no comparable part-time warehouse job with benefits in this market can match.

jobs.description:
Position in Chicago, IL

Snapshot

  • Flexible contract/gig opportunity in Chicago.
  • Worksite: Chicago, IL
  • Benefits: A competitive compensation package is offered.
  • Flexible Role in Chicago: Part-time Morning Warehouse — Done By 9AM
  • This role centers on your professional skills within the Package Logistics space in Chicago.
  • Compensation: $17-$20/Hour (approx. $22.9k/Year)
  • Company: UPS
  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our UPS team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Package Logistics industry.

About UPS & Our Culture

Four to five hours. That is all UPS asks of its morning preload associates — and in return, you receive Teamsters union wages, full medical benefits, a pension contribution, and a completely free day starting before 9:30 AM. Our Part-Time Morning Warehouse position is the best-kept secret in the local job market for parents who need school-drop-off mornings free, freelancers who want their afternoons uninterrupted, and anyone who simply values owning their day. When you search for morning warehouse jobs near me that pay well and end early, UPS preload is the answer that consistently surprises people who find it.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I drop my kids off at school at 7:45 AM and I am already done with my UPS shift. I work 4:00 AM to 8:30 AM, and the entire rest of my day belongs to me. The union wage plus the morning shift differential adds up to a paycheck that covers my car payment and insurance with money left over. I have recommended this to every parent I know who is looking for morning warehouse jobs near me — nothing else in this market ends this early and pays this well." - Current Morning Preload Associate, San Antonio, TX.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Part-Time Morning Warehouse Associate, you work the preload sort shift — typically 4:00 AM to 8:30 AM — inside our package center, sorting inbound overnight freight and building outbound package car loads that every UPS driver depends on to run a clean, efficient delivery route throughout the day.

  • Early Morning Inbound Sort: Process inbound overnight package volume from the network's linehaul trailers, sorting every parcel to the correct outbound car or lane using barcode scanning and load chart reference during the critical pre-departure window.
  • Package Car Load Building: Build delivery vehicle loads in precise stop-sequence order, ensuring every driver can pull their route efficiently from the first stop to the last without searching for misplaced freight inside the vehicle.
  • Shift Completion by 9 AM: Consistently finish your sort assignment and vehicle inspection before the morning departure window, freeing your entire day for family, school, freelance work, or a second career without any schedule conflict whatsoever.

Benefits & Perks

UPS Part-Time Morning Associates earn a meaningful early-morning shift differential on top of Teamsters union base wages, with full medical, dental, and vision benefits, pension accrual, paid personal days, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance — all on a schedule that ends before most people finish their morning coffee. Weekly direct-deposit paychecks make this one of the most financially practical morning warehouse jobs available anywhere in the logistics market.

jobs.description:
Local Job Overview: East Chicago

Job Title: Night Sort Warehouse Associate Company: UPS Location: East Chicago, IN

Salary: $23-$27/Hour (approx. $30.7k/Year) Benefits: A comprehensive benefits package is included. Clear growth pathways at our East Chicago office.

Position Scope

Core objectives involve your professional skills in Package Logistics.

  • This East Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our UPS team in East Chicago, IN is growing.
  • Benefit from working in East Chicago, a key hub for the Package Logistics industry.

About UPS & Our Culture

While most of the city powers down for the night, UPS powers up. The night sort is the highest-volume, highest-urgency shift in our entire package center operation — the window where the day's accumulated commercial and residential pickups are sorted and loaded onto linehaul trailers that must depart on hard schedules before dawn. If you are a night owl searching for UPS warehouse jobs that pair serious overnight pay differentials with the intensity of a world-class sort operation, our night sort shift is the most financially rewarding entry-level window in our entire logistics careers portfolio.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"The night sort is not for people who want to ease into their shift — it is full speed from the moment the belt starts. But the overnight differential genuinely adds up to a paycheck that beats every comparable warehouse job in this area. I am home by 3 AM, my days are completely free, and the Earn & Learn program is funding my degree while I sleep. UPS night sort is the best-kept secret in the local job market." - Current Night Sort Warehouse Associate, Philadelphia, PA.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Night Sort Warehouse Associate, you process the facility's peak nightly commercial pickup volume during the late-night sort window, working at sustained high intensity to clear the sort floor before hard linehaul trailer departure deadlines inside our package center.

  • High-Volume Commercial Sort Processing: Sort the dense volume of business pickup packages collected by UPS drivers throughout the afternoon, reading destination labels and routing every parcel accurately to its correct outbound trailer lane at peak belt speed.
  • Linehaul Trailer Loading: Load completed outbound pallets and loose packages onto 53-foot linehaul trailers under hard departure window constraints, maximizing trailer cube while maintaining load quality standards that prevent damage during long-distance transport.
  • Departure Deadline Compliance: Work with precise awareness of each trailer's hard departure time, prioritizing the loading sequence to ensure every linehaul trailer is sealed, documented, and released to the yard before its scheduled pull time.

Benefits & Perks

Night Sort Warehouse Associates earn a substantial overnight shift differential on top of the Teamsters base hourly wage — one of the highest total hourly rates available at the entry level across all warehouse jobs in the UPS network. Full Teamsters medical, dental, vision, pension, UPS Earn & Learn tuition funding, and paid personal time are included from day one of eligibility.

jobs.description:
Role Based in Chicago

Key Information

  • Employer: UPS (Hiring in Chicago)
  • Salary: $20-$24/Hour (approx. $46.2k/Year)
  • Benefits: A competitive compensation package is offered.
  • Job Title: Full-time Night Shift Warehouse Unloader (Gig/Contract)
  • Flexible contract/gig opportunity in Chicago.
  • Based in: Chicago, IL (a vibrant local hub)
  • Apply your your professional skills skills at our Chicago location.
  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our UPS team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Package Logistics industry.

About UPS & Our Culture

The night shift unload is the most physically demanding and most financially rewarding entry-level position in the UPS warehouse network. Our Full-Time Night Shift Unloaders are the associates who set the entire sort operation in motion every evening — pulling packages from trailers at sustained speed so that the entire downstream sort, load, and dispatch chain can execute without interruption. If you are seeking full-time night shift warehouse jobs that pay a premium for working hours others avoid, reward physical effort with contractually guaranteed union wages, and open the door to one of the most financially powerful blue-collar careers in America, this is the opportunity you have been looking for.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I specifically wanted a full-time night shift because I do not want to deal with traffic and I am naturally a night person. The UPS overnight differential on top of the full-time union wage makes my take-home pay genuinely outstanding for the skill level required to start. I have been here four years, I make more than most of my college-educated friends, and I am currently in the line for a full-time driver position. Full-time night shift warehouse jobs do not get better than this." - Current Full-Time Night Shift Unloader, Memphis, TN.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Full-Time Night Shift Warehouse Unloader, you work an 8-hour overnight shift inside our package center, leading the high-velocity inbound unload operation that processes all trailers arriving during the night sort window and sets up the entire sort floor for the day ahead.

  • High-Speed Trailer Unloading: Pull packages from fully loaded 53-foot inbound trailers at a sustained rate across a full 8-hour shift, placing every parcel label-side up on the inbound conveyor belt to maintain sort floor throughput targets through the peak overnight window.
  • Inbound Freight Verification: Identify and flag trailer shortages, damaged freight, and hazmat packages at the point of unload before any problem item enters the main sort flow, protecting downstream sort accuracy and compliance.
  • Dock Safety Leadership: Model UPS safety protocols — trailer chocking, dock plate seating, and heavy-lift team technique — for newer associates in the unload area, setting the standard that keeps the night shift injury-free shift after shift.

Benefits & Perks

UPS Full-Time Night Shift Unloaders earn a significant overnight shift differential stacked on top of the full-time Teamsters union base wage — one of the highest total hourly rates available in the package logistics industry without a CDL. Full medical, dental, and vision benefits, a defined-benefit pension, paid vacation, sick time, paid holidays, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance are all included. Weekly paychecks are direct-deposited every Friday.

High-Speed Trailer Unloading: Pull packages from fully loaded 53-foot inbound trailers at a sustained rate across a full 8-hour shift, placing every parcel label-side up on the inbound conveyor belt to maintain sort floor throughput targets through the peak overnight window

Inbound Freight Verification: Identify and flag trailer shortages, damaged freight, and hazmat packages at the point of unload before any problem item enters the main sort flow, protecting downstream sort accuracy and compliance

Fast Facts

What You Get

  • Salary: $23-$26/Hour (approx. $30.3k/Year)
  • Benefits: This role offers competitive pay.
  • Set your own schedule.

What You'll Do

  • Apply your your professional skills skills at our Chicago location.

About UPS & Our Culture

Friday evening through Sunday night — that is when the UPS weekend operation runs at its highest volume, and it is when our Weekend Warehouse Package Handlers earn some of the strongest hourly rates in our entire package center network. If your Monday-through-Friday schedule is locked and you are hunting for weekend warehouse jobs that actually pay well, offer union benefits, and leave every weekday untouched, UPS weekend shifts were designed specifically for you. We are one of the only employers in the logistics industry offering weekend warehouse jobs near me with full Teamsters union representation, meaning your weekend hours come with the same contractual protections and pay guarantees as any full-time role.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I have a full-time desk job Monday through Friday and I work UPS weekends to pay down my mortgage faster. The weekend differential on top of the union wage makes the hourly rate genuinely excellent, and I get my full weekdays completely untouched. In two years I have built a serious financial cushion on this schedule. If you are looking for legitimate weekend warehouse jobs near me that respect your weekday life, UPS is it." - Current Weekend Package Handler, Indianapolis, IN.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Weekend Warehouse Package Handler, you work Friday evening through Sunday sort shifts inside our package center, processing the weekend's elevated residential delivery and pickup volume that builds throughout the week and peaks on Saturday and Sunday sort windows.

  • Weekend Volume Processing: Sort, load, and unload the high-density package volume that accumulates through the week, operating at peak throughput across Friday night, Saturday, and Sunday shifts to clear the facility for Monday morning delivery routes.
  • Weekend Surge Handling: Navigate the additional volume generated by weekend e-commerce orders and residential pickups, adapting quickly to higher-than-weekday sort targets that UPS weekend shifts routinely reach.
  • Trailer Loading & Unloading: Pull inbound packages from arriving trailers and build outbound loads in package cars and linehaul lanes, using UPS-approved stacking methods to maintain load quality standards across all weekend shifts.

Benefits & Perks

UPS Weekend Warehouse Package Handlers receive a weekend shift differential on top of the Teamsters base union wage. Full medical, dental, and vision benefits, pension accrual, paid personal time, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance apply regardless of your part-time weekend schedule. Weekly paychecks are direct-deposited every Friday. Your entire Monday-through-Friday schedule remains completely untouched.
